title: feat(ownvec): own incoming lock vector: reverse UNDEFINED, face fails
science: Own unique incoming lock readout on nnseed x-probes. Load-bearing as a controlled contrast: on the SAME process and SAME probes the already-recorded-neighbour readout gives L(C)=-e_2, L(D)=+e_2 and face HOLDS, while the own-incoming readout gives L(C)=L(D)=+e_1 and face FAILS. The verdict is a property of the readout, not of the lattice process.
